palette: black ink, diluted charcoal, calm ivory, sparse cinnabar plum

shots.movement: ink forms from the wrapped wrist toward the silver flower; slow macro push
match the offering gesture; accelerate toward the two faces
separate portrait and distant wash; sweep foreground branch
restrained reaction; ink descends into the collar
open into mist; accelerate along the canal toward the bridge
diagonal sabre reveal and forward camera move
a closer camera cut following the robe and blade
near branch, separate full-body figure, distant village travel at different speeds

shots.text: 삼류연정 / 三流戀情 / 한 사람의 강호

method: newly generated ink paintings, layered camera animation, procedural brush masks and particles, cinematic audio edit
